aibase_desc: AI model resource: model name, API key and validity period.
api_key_help_empty: Leave empty to keep the stored key (or to save without a key).
api_key_help_set: A key is configured (%mask%). Leave empty to keep it.
restriction_type_help: One of three (mutually exclusive): none (no limit), time range (validity window), count (max cumulative calls per user).
access_start_at_help: Start of the validity window in time-range mode (empty = no start bound).
access_end_at_help: End of the validity window in time-range mode (empty = no end bound).
usage_limit_help: Cumulative calls per user (applies in count mode; empty = platform default, 20).
is_default_help: The platform-wide default AI resource (only one).
expires_at_help: Leave empty for no time limit.
ai_test_desc: Sends a message to verify the AI model connection is usable (each successful call consumes 1 trial credit).
ai_test_default_prompt: Hi, introduce yourself in one sentence.
ai_test_error_no_permission: No permission to access the resource
ai_test_error_expired: Resource expired, please contact an administrator
ai_test_error_restricted: Access limit exceeded, please retry later or contact an administrator
ai_test_error_key_decrypt: Failed to decrypt the API key
ai_test_error_network: Network error, please try again later
inputs_help: Select resources to use as inputs of this resource. The order defines the display order.
